name: thimble
description: thimble: notebook-backed analysis of agent runs inside a Claude Code session. Two plugins: thimble, sourced from ./plugin of this tree (its version is plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json's), and thimble-cc-mod, sourced from ./mods/thimble-cc-mod.

plugins.name: thimble
plugins.description: Turns a Claude Code session into an analyst workbench over the agent transcripts in the working directory: the thimble MCP tools, its hooks, the /thimble skill and the `thimble` launcher. Needs the thimble server installed beside it (scripts/install.sh).

plugins.name: thimble-cc-mod
plugins.description: A single-agent thimble inside Claude Code: it answers with cards drawn in the chat and citations you can check. An exploration.
